
ADD-DEPENDENCIES
Add multiple dependency relationships to a work unit at once

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command to add multiple dependency relationships to a work unit in a single command, instead of calling add-dependency multiple times. Efficient for setting up complex dependency graphs.

PREREQUISITES
  • Work unit must exist in spec/work-units.json
  • Target work units must exist

USAGE
  fspec add-dependencies <workUnitId> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID to add dependencies to (e.g., AUTH-001)

OPTIONS
  --blocks <ids...>
    Space-separated list of work unit IDs that this work unit blocks
  --blocked-by <ids...>
    Space-separated list of work unit IDs that block this work unit
  --depends-on <ids...>
    Space-separated list of work unit IDs this work unit depends on
  --relates-to <ids...>
    Space-separated list of related work unit IDs (non-blocking association)

COMMON PATTERNS
  • Setting Up Dependency Chain
    Example: # API depends on DB schema and auth
fspec add-dependencies API-001 --depends-on DB-001 AUTH-001

# UI depends on API
fspec add-dependencies UI-001 --depends-on API-001
    undefined

  • Marking Blockers
    Example: # Critical bug blocks multiple features
fspec add-dependencies BUG-001 --blocks FEAT-001 FEAT-002 FEAT-003
    undefined

  • Related Work (Non-Blocking)
    Example: # Documentation relates to multiple features
fspec add-dependencies DOC-001 --relates-to AUTH-001 API-001 UI-001
    undefined


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  1. Create work units → 2. Identify dependencies → 3. fspec add-dependencies <id> --depends-on <deps> → 4. Verify: fspec dependencies <id>

EXAMPLES
  1. Add multiple dependencies and relations
  $ fspec add-dependencies AUTH-001 --depends-on AUTH-002 AUTH-003 --relates-to UI-001
  ✓ Added 3 dependencies successfully

  2. Mark work unit as blocked by multiple dependencies
  $ fspec add-dependencies API-001 --blocked-by DB-001 DB-002
  ✓ Added 2 dependencies successfully

  3. Mark work unit as blocking multiple other units
  $ fspec add-dependencies UI-001 --blocks UI-002 UI-003 UI-004
  ✓ Added 3 dependencies successfully

  4. Add related work units (non-blocking relationships)
  $ fspec add-dependencies REFAC-001 --relates-to AUTH-001 API-001 DB-001
  ✓ Added 3 dependencies successfully

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Error: Work unit AUTH-001 does not exist
    Fix: Ensure work unit exists. Run: fspec list-work-units

  ✗ Error: Target work unit DB-001 does not exist
    Fix: All target work units must exist before adding dependencies

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-dependency
  fspec remove-dependency
  fspec dependencies
  fspec export-dependencies
  fspec suggest-dependencies

NOTES
  • All options accept space-separated lists of work unit IDs
  • Each relationship is validated before being added
  • Automatically creates bidirectional relationships where appropriate
  • More efficient than multiple add-dependency calls
  • Use --relates-to for associations that do not imply blocking or dependency
